about: The source team talked through two public vaults (its team/conductor/vaults.json at 298be4e). This team never created them: at the editor's word (30 October 2026, 01:58 UTC) the same layouts live as folders in this repository, comms/issues (Issues-FS lite) and comms/mail (Email-FS lite), with git as the medium. Both are as public as the vaults were: the repository and its site are public. No vault, so no read key and no vault key.

folders.name: comms/issues
folders.layout: comms/issues/<agent>/issues/{open,blocked,done}/NNN-kebab-slug.md; read every folder, write only your own

folders.name: comms/mail
folders.layout: comms/mail/mailroom/<recipient>/<sender>__NNN-slug.eml (new; the sender owns it); comms/mail/<agent>/{inbox,done,outbox}/ (only that agent writes)
